title: Distilling Feedback into Memory-as-a-Tool
paper_type_zh: 反馈数据与 Agent 记忆论文
best_for_zh: 希望复用连续评审反馈并控制 Agent 推理成本的研究者。
one_line: Memory-as-a-Tool distils recurring rubric feedback into retrievable, updateable files to amortize refinement cost.
将重复 rubric 批评蒸馏为 Agent 可检索、更新的文件记忆，以降低后续改写成本。
why: It exposes rubric-grounded evaluation signals and their audit boundary.
inclusion_reason: The release provides rubric- or judgment-grounded records that can train, evaluate, or audit LLM-based evaluators.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time refinement repeatedly reads a rubric, generates critique, and revises each new sample. It can improve quality but incurs repeated reasoning cost, and historical feedback is not accumulated as reusable knowledge. Static prompt summaries also cannot be selected, updated, or retired by task.

The work distils recurring rubric feedback into persistent human-readable memory files and lets an agent retrieve and update them through tools so later tasks reuse prior experience.

test-time refinement 常让模型针对每个新样本重复读取 rubric、生成批评并改写，虽然能提高质量，却产生大量重复推理成本，历史反馈也不会积累为可复用知识。静态提示总结又无法按任务选择、更新或删除过时经验。

该工作把多次 rubric feedback 蒸馏成人类可读的持久 memory 文件，并允许 Agent 通过工具检索和更新，使后续任务直接复用经验。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Rubric Feedback Bench contains forty-two scenarios in five task groups, recording prompts, task rubrics, and quantitative or textual feedback. It is English and contains fewer than one thousand records. Instance-level critiques are abstracted into reusable guidelines stored as external file memory, which an agent decides when to read, apply, and update. Data and code support feedback distillation, persistent memory, and cost–quality analysis.
Rubric Feedback Bench 含 42 个任务场景、五类任务组，记录 prompt、任务 rubric 以及量化或文本反馈，英文发布且规模小于 1K。方法把实例级 critique 抽象为可复用 guideline，写入外部文件 memory；Agent 在推理时决定何时读取、应用和更新。数据与代码可用于反馈蒸馏、持久记忆和成本—质量比较。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect rubric feedback: A baseline agent produces outputs for forty-two scenarios, and evaluators return rubric scores and textual critiques.
  1. Distil reusable rules: Recurring critiques are distilled into cross-instance guidelines, excluding details specific to one answer.
  1. Write tool memory: Guidelines are stored in readable files that the agent can query, append, merge, or revise instead of a fixed context template.
  1. Reuse and update: Later tasks retrieve relevant memory before answering, and new evaluation updates it; evaluator, memory budget, and update policy must be fixed.

1. 收集 rubric feedback： 基线 Agent 在 42 个场景上生成输出，评价器按任务 rubric 给出分数和自然语言批评。
  1. 抽象可复用规则： 系统从重复批评中提取跨实例 guideline，删除只针对单个答案的细节。
  1. 写入工具化 memory： 规则保存在可读文件中，Agent 可通过工具查询、追加、合并或修订，而不是塞入固定上下文模板。
  1. 复用与更新： 后续任务先检索相关 memory 再作答，新的评价继续更新规则；复现需固定 evaluator、记忆预算和更新策略。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that memory-as-a-tool approaches the quality of iterative critique–refinement while substantially reducing later inference and feedback cost, and that accumulated guidelines transfer across related scenarios. The accessible abstract does not provide one safely reproducible unified number, so no percentage is invented here. The evidence supports feedback distillation, but forty-two scenarios do not establish long-term stability or broad transfer.
论文报告，memory-as-a-tool 能较快达到迭代 critique–refinement 的质量，同时显著减少后续推理调用和反馈成本；积累的 guideline 还可跨同类场景复用。当前可访问摘要未给出一组足以安全复述的统一数字，因此文档不虚构百分比。证据支持反馈蒸馏思路，但只有 42 个场景，长期错误积累和跨域迁移仍未充分验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Traditional self-refinement regenerates critique for every sample, while memory methods often concatenate history into context. This work compresses feedback into human-readable rules and exposes memory operations as agent tools, making knowledge selective, updateable, and auditable. The novelty is feedback-to-memory transformation and tool access rather than a new base model.
传统 self-refinement 对每个样本重新生成 critique，记忆方法则常把历史直接拼接进上下文。本文的改变是把反馈压缩为人类可读规则，并将记忆操作暴露为 Agent 工具，使知识可选择、可更新、可审计。新意在 feedback-to-memory 转换和工具接口，而不是新的基础模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Forty-two scenarios across five task groups may overestimate transfer among related tasks.
  1. Limitation 2: Incorrect or biased feedback can be consolidated into persistent memory and repeatedly propagated.
  1. Limitation 3: Rule merging, conflict resolution, and forgetting affect results, while long-term large-scale degradation is not established.

1. 局限1： 42 个场景与五类任务规模较小，容易高估同类任务间迁移。
  1. 局限2： 错误或带偏见的反馈会被固化进持久 memory，并在后续任务中重复传播。
  1. 局限3： 规则合并、冲突处理和遗忘策略影响结果，论文未覆盖长期大规模记忆退化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Distil recurring human or LLM critiques into team-readable guidelines to reduce later review cost.
  1. Use case 2: Use Rubric Feedback Bench to compare no memory, history concatenation, and tool memory on quality and calls.
  1. Use case 3: High-risk use needs human approval and version rollback for memory updates to prevent persistent errors.

1. 使用场景1： 可将重复人工或 LLM critique 蒸馏为团队可读 guideline，降低同类任务后续评审成本。
  1. 使用场景2： 可用 Rubric Feedback Bench 比较无记忆、直接历史拼接和 memory tool 的质量/调用成本。
  1. 使用场景3： 高风险任务应为 memory 更新设置人工审批和版本回滚，避免错误规则长期传播。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Distil repeated rubric critiques into persistent, updateable agent guidelines.
  2. Method: Feedback collection, rule abstraction, file-memory tools, and continual updating.
  3. Data: Rubric Feedback Bench has forty-two scenarios in five groups with prompts, rubrics, and feedback.
  4. Evidence: Quality approaches iterative refinement while later inference cost falls; no unified number is claimed.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for repetitive workflows; add approval, conflict handling, and rollback.

1. 一句话定位： 把重复 rubric 批评蒸馏为 Agent 可调用、可更新的持久规则。
  2. 方法抓手： 反馈收集、规则抽象、文件 memory 工具和持续更新。
  3. 数据抓手： Rubric Feedback Bench 含 42 场景、五任务组、prompt、rubric 与反馈。
  4. 证据锚点： 质量接近反复 refinement，同时显著减少后续推理成本；摘要未给统一数值。
  5. 复用决定： 适合重复工作流反馈复用；必须加入 memory 审批、冲突和回滚机制。
